selection_reason: The official INEI census index exposes a 2017 REDATAM database at manzana level, which is currently a finer documented spatial product than the public 2025 first-results entry. Selection is provisional until reproducible extraction and geometry alignment are proven.
recency_rule: Prefer fitness for analytical purpose over publication year alone. A newer source does not replace an older structural source unless compatible geography, variables, coverage and reproducible access are demonstrated.
required_extraction_evidence: reproducible population table for Lima province
stable geographic identifier at the finest usable census geography
matching or officially reconcilable geometry identifier
population totals reconciled against a coarser official control total
documented census reference date and static-snapshot semantics
spatial_alignment_tests: population conservation after areal allocation if boundaries are not nested
sensitivity to allocation method for partially intersecting manzanas

allocation_policy.preferred: Use stable geographic keys when analytical units nest cleanly within census geography.
allocation_policy.conditional: If grid cells cut census polygons, test area-weighted allocation and do not imply that population is uniformly distributed without documenting the approximation.
allocation_policy.future_option: Use ancillary built-up/residential information for dasymetric allocation only if the added source and method are separately validated.

2025_census_policy: Re-evaluate when INEI publishes a reproducible fine-geography product compatible with the analytical pipeline. Do not mix 2017 and 2025 values as if they were the same reference snapshot.
